name: Cheech & Chong - 2g D.A.V.E Vapes - Northern Lights
description:
Earthy, sweet, and deeply smooth. The Cheech & Chong Northern Lights D.A.V.E vape packs 2 grams of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — into a sleek, ready-to-go device. No cartridges, no setup, no fuss. Just draw and enjoy.

Northern Lights carries one of the most recognizable profiles in cannabis: earthy pine and sweet herbal notes up front, layered with a soft spicy warmth and a smooth, resinous finish. It's a classic, full-bodied flavor made for winding down and taking it slow.

Why you'll love it:

2G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Northern Lights flavor — earthy pine and sweet herbs with a warm, spicy finish
Smooth, consistent pulls — flavorful from the first draw to the last
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Classic flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Cheech & Chong Northern Lights is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
